name: Ticket triage
description: Mixed primitives over one support ticket: a noul, a choice and two scores. Mirrors the SDK demo. Fill `${subject}` and `${body}` from an input set (starting set: double-charge).

isBilling.instructions: Is this ticket (`subject` and `body`) about billing or payments?

tone.instructions: What is the customer's tone in `body`?

criteria.calm: Neutral or polite, no visible frustration
criteria.frustrated: Annoyed or impatient, but still civil

urgency.instructions: How urgently does this ticket need a response?
criteria: Can wait a week or more

refundRisk.instructions: How likely is the customer to demand a refund?
